domains.title: Algorithms and Formal Methods
domains.question: Can a system prove or falsify its safety, consistency and complexity claims?
domains.boundary: A solver result is limited to its model, assumptions and bounded state space.

references.name: TLA+
references.why: Specify state machines and inspect concurrency invariants.

references.name: Alloy
references.why: Explore relational models and bounded counterexamples.

references.name: Z3
references.why: Test satisfiability and constraints with a maintained SMT solver.

references.name: Lean
references.why: Build machine-checked proofs with explicit assumptions.

domains.title: Distributed Systems and Consensus
domains.question: What remains correct when nodes fail, partitions occur and clocks disagree?
domains.boundary: A single-node throughput result says nothing about distributed correctness.

references.name: etcd
references.why: Study a production-oriented distributed key-value control plane.

references.name: FoundationDB
references.why: Examine transactional storage and fault-injection testing.

references.name: Jepsen
references.why: Investigate observable consistency under failures.

references.name: NATS
references.why: Compare messaging semantics and operational recovery.

domains.title: Internet Routing and Network Protocols
domains.question: How do independent networks preserve reachability without trusting every announcement?
domains.boundary: References are for read-only analysis and offline simulation, not live route control.

references.name: BGP-4 RFC 4271
references.why: Defines inter-autonomous-system reachability exchange.

references.name: RPKI Origin Validation RFC 6811
references.why: Defines origin-validation behavior for BGP routes.

references.name: FRRouting
references.why: Offers an inspectable routing implementation for controlled labs.

references.name: RIPE Atlas
references.why: Provides a public platform for Internet reachability measurement.

domains.title: Identity, Privileged Access and Post-Quantum Cryptography
domains.question: Who may act, how quickly can that authority be revoked, and can cryptography evolve safely?
domains.boundary: A policy engine does not replace authenticated identity or certified cryptographic modules.

references.name: NIST Zero Trust Architecture
references.why: Frames resource-centered access decisions without implicit location trust.

references.name: SPIFFE
references.why: Defines workload identity across heterogeneous systems.

references.name: OpenBao
references.why: Provides an inspectable secrets-management implementation.

references.name: NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography
references.why: Tracks finalized PQC algorithms and migration guidance.

domains.title: Databases, Knowledge Graphs and Business Intelligence
domains.question: Can decisions be reproduced from fresh, permissioned and traceable data?
domains.boundary: Fast retrieval is not evidence that a source is correct or licensed.

references.name: Apache Iceberg
references.why: Defines versioned analytical table snapshots and evolution.

references.name: Apache Arrow Flight
references.why: Defines high-throughput transport for Arrow data services.

references.name: DuckDB
references.why: Makes local analytical reproduction accessible.

references.name: Apache Superset
references.why: Offers inspectable data exploration and BI interfaces.

domains.title: Statistics, Machine Learning and Causal Science
domains.question: Does a model improve independently accepted decisions beyond a simpler baseline?
domains.boundary: Prediction, intervention effects and generative plausibility are different claims.

references.name: scikit-learn
references.why: Supplies transparent classical-ML baselines and evaluation utilities.

references.name: PyTorch
references.why: Supports reproducible deep-learning research and deployment.

references.name: DoWhy
references.why: Makes causal assumptions, estimation and refutation explicit.

references.name: MLflow
references.why: Tracks model experiments and artifacts for reproducible comparison.

domains.title: Agent Protocols, Memory and GraphRAG
domains.question: Can independent agents exchange tasks and use bounded, source-linked memory correctly?
domains.boundary: Logical agent registration is not active execution or upstream conformance.

references.name: A2A Protocol
references.why: Defines interoperable agent discovery and task exchange.

references.name: Model Context Protocol
references.why: Defines interoperable tool and context interfaces.

references.name: LangGraph
references.why: Offers explicit graph-based workflow and state patterns.

references.name: LongMemEval-V2
references.why: Provides a long-history memory evaluation reference.

domains.title: Cloud Infrastructure, HPC and AI Inference
domains.question: What is the reliable cost of serving accepted work at real active load?
domains.boundary: Tokens per second alone do not capture task quality, GPU idle cost or human review.

references.name: Kubernetes
references.why: Defines common container orchestration primitives.

references.name: Ray
references.why: Supports distributed execution across ML and agent workloads.

references.name: vLLM
references.why: Offers a reference high-throughput model-serving engine.

references.name: MLPerf Inference
references.why: Provides a governed datacenter inference measurement suite.

domains.title: Robotics, Control and Digital Twins
domains.question: Does a simulated policy remain safe and effective under physical uncertainty?
domains.boundary: Simulator performance is not an airworthiness, industrial or classified-use approval.

references.name: ROS 2
references.why: Provides common robotic software interfaces.

references.name: MuJoCo
references.why: Enables controlled physics simulation experiments.

references.name: BEHAVIOR-1K
references.why: Provides embodied tasks tied to human activity needs.

references.name: LIBERO
references.why: Measures lifelong robot manipulation performance.

domains.title: Human-Computer Interaction and Human Command
domains.question: Can people understand, override and safely command increasingly complex automation?
domains.boundary: More alerts and faster clicks do not establish better decisions.

references.name: NASA Task Load Index
references.why: Provides a structured subjective workload instrument.

references.name: W3C WCAG
references.why: Defines testable web accessibility guidance.

references.name: D3
references.why: Supports inspectable interactive data graphics.

references.name: Cytoscape.js
references.why: Provides graph visualization and interaction primitives.
